topics.topic: Whether duplicate agent names are allowed after configuration reload
questions: When the changed token list contains two agents with the same name but distinct valid tokens, must the re-read reject the list or accept two indistinguishable agent actors?
When a changed configuration repeats an `agent_name`, must the per-request re-read reject the new token list, or may it install two tokens that produce the same Actor identity?

quotes: names are unique in an installation, and a configuration repeating one is refused at start.

Exactly three checks apply to a re-read: the
   file can be read and parsed; every token is at least 43 characters; no two
   tokens are equal.
judgement.why: The first passage requires unique agent names, while the exhaustive re-read checks omit that requirement and therefore allow duplicate names after reload.

topics.topic: Authority required when retrying a read after service_unreachable
questions: When a `read` element waiting on `service_unreachable` is resumed, does it send again without authority, or must it find an approval or grant?

topics.topic: Failure and rollback semantics for startup recovery
questions: What happens if a store read, record change, or spool removal fails during startup recovery?
Does “no partial start” mean only that the MCP surface is never opened, or must all recovery writes be rolled back if any later startup step fails?

topics.topic: Ownership and capability path for supplying file-input bytes to service requests
questions: For a read operation with a file input, which module reads the SpooledFile bytes and through which capability are those bytes supplied to service_invoker.prepare_request?

topics.topic: Ownership of contract_violation when file-output spooling exceeds limits
questions: Who produces contract_violation when a valid 2xx file response is rejected by store.spool_file because a file or run spool ceiling is exceeded, given that service_invoker does not see the run spool?

topics.topic: Ownership of random, collision-checked entity ID generation
questions: Which module or capability supplies randomness and collision-checked minting for `trial_execution_id`, `binding_id`, `run_id`, `approval_id` and `grant_id`?
